digest_text: This week Pakistani developers pushed 42 notable repositories across AI/ML, web development, and DevOps. The AI/ML space saw significant activity with several new training pipelines and model serving frameworks, while the web development cohort focused on Next.js applications and real-time systems. On the DevOps front, there was a notable push toward Kubernetes-native tooling and CI/CD optimization. Several developers contributed to open-source libraries including a new React state management solution and a Python data validation library. The ecosystem continues to show strong momentum in AI infrastructure and full-stack web development.
